pages.title: Snack Stack
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Snack Stack takes you to an Asian food market where the dishes are puzzle pieces. Pick tiles showing crab, corn, eggs, and other foods, then collect three of a kind to free space in the tray. Each pick exposes more of the board, but filling the tray ends the attempt. Use Undo or Shuffle when a level leaves you short of a match.

pages.title: Vex 10
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Vex 10 adds new ways to get through a trap-filled platforming Act. Reverse gravity to cross a ceiling, rotate platforms to open a route, or freeze time to get past a hazard. Some sections ask you to switch characters, while Challenge Mode puts several Vex characters under your control at once. Keep an eye out for traps that are hidden from view.

pages.title: Grand Fruit Connect
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Pick matching fruit tiles from the layered board in Grand Fruit Connect. Every tile you take goes into a tray, so look for a set you can finish before the tray fills. Clearing tiles makes more of the board available. Use a booster when you need help getting to the next match.

pages.title: Summer Onet Connect
pages.creator: 2Million Games
pages.description: Summer Onet Connect is a beach-themed puzzle about clearing tiles in pairs. Look for two identical pictures with a route between them, then clear the pair to open up more of the board. The game includes a timer, plus hint and shuffle boosters for when the next match is hard to find.

pages.title: Match Ten Number Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Drag numbers together in Match Ten Number Puzzle so their total reaches ten and the numbers disappear. Clear the required numbers before the timer runs out. Look for combinations that leave you another useful move, and try a hint or refresh the board if you get stuck.

pages.title: Dalgona Game2
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Free the stamped shape from a piece of dalgona candy in Dalgona Game2. Work around the outline a little at a time so the design comes out in one piece. Pay particular attention to tight corners where a slip can break the part you are trying to save.

pages.title: Obby Rainbow Tower
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Race up a winter obstacle course in Obby Rainbow Tower. Time your jumps past spinning lava bars and moving platforms, and watch your footing on the icy tiles. Snowstorms and snowball portals can knock you into the void. Run the tower again to beat your own time or race alongside a friend in two-player mode.

pages.title: Kick Loser
pages.creator: Eyestorm Pte. LTD.
pages.description: Kick Loser is a physics puzzle in which you launch a stickman into objects to deal as much damage as possible. Drag to set up each kick and experiment with the angle and force. Different objects react differently, so watch how the first impact changes where the stickman goes next.

pages.title: Smartle
pages.creator: Pro Mobile
pages.description: Swap letters on a five-by-five grid in Smartle until each row spells a five-letter word. There can be several valid solutions to the same board. Look at the letters you would be taking away from other rows before you commit to a word, since a good swap can help both rows take shape.

pages.title: Agent Squad
pages.creator: Ohayō
pages.description: Work through a series of top-down shootouts in Agent Squad. Move through each area and take out every enemy to unlock the next stage. As you build up your arsenal, unlock new guns and improve the ones you use. The view from above helps you track threats on different sides of your character.

pages.title: Geometry Open World
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Pilot a ship through a geometric open world in Geometry Open World. Steer around obstacles, fight enemies along your route, and take on bosses as you build up your ship. Use upgrades and special abilities to prepare for tougher encounters, then choose where to fly next.

pages.title: Bolts and Nuts - Puzzle
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Free the wooden planks in Bolts and Nuts - Puzzle by moving bolts into empty holes. Take a moment to see which planks each bolt supports, since moving one can free a board and expose another fastener. If you get stuck, a screwdriver can remove a bolt and a time-freeze tool can pause the countdown.

pages.title: Soccer Dash
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: In Soccer Dash, guide a football past players and obstacles one kick at a time. Drag to choose the direction, then release to send the ball along that line. The action slows down while you aim, giving you time to spot a gap and set up the kick that takes the ball closer to goal.

pages.title: Visual Memory Drag Drop
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Visual Memory Drag Drop shows you a pattern and asks you to recreate it from memory. Drag the circles into the positions you remember once the example is gone. The early rounds let you get used to the layout, while later stages give you more demanding patterns to hold in your head.

pages.title: Geometry Vertical
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Geometry Vertical changes how you steer depending on what you control. Shift the cube between lanes, hold and release to adjust the rocket's angle, or steer a car before letting it straighten out. Read the approaching geometric obstacles and get used to each mode's movement before the finish.

pages.title: Toilet Roll
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Toilet Roll gives you sixty seconds to see how many rolls you can unwind. Pull the paper quickly enough to get through roll after roll, but keep it from tearing or you will lose time. Points from your runs can be spent on upgrades for another attempt.

pages.title: Dye Fashion
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Choose a dress in Dye Fashion and use color to change how it looks. Start with a cut that suits the design you have in mind, from a casual dress to an evening gown. Then decide where to use strong colors and where to keep the tones closer together.

pages.title: Gothic Dress Up
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description: Style six characters in Gothic Dress Up using pieces such as tartan skirts, Edwardian blouses, and dark makeup. Build an outfit around the silhouette you want, then add wings if you want to lean into the fallen-angel look. The wardrobe gives you room to move between gothic lolita and more formal styles.

pages.title: Super Count Masters
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Start with one stickman in Super Count Masters and lead him through gates that add fighters to the group. Choose a route that leaves you with enough people to take on rival crowds and bosses. Collect coins to upgrade the crowd as you work through the game's 20 levels.

pages.title: Agent Alpha
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Slide to move through each shooting stage in Agent Alpha. Defeat every enemy to open the next level, and keep moving as you line up the remaining targets. More guns become available as you play, giving you different weapons to take into later encounters.

pages.title: Squicky
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Help a mouse rescue his friends in Squicky. Jump through the stages and search for all the keys needed to move on. Coins and defeated enemies add to your score, so explore the platforms for extra points as you work toward unlocking the next stage.

pages.title: Tangram Grid
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Fit seven tangram pieces into the outline in Tangram Grid. Cover the entire grid and make sure none of the pieces overlap. Start by looking at corners or narrow sections that only a few shapes can fit, then see how the remaining pieces can fill the space.

pages.title: Lost In The Maze
pages.creator: DevDude
pages.description: Lost In The Maze puts you in a procedurally generated labyrinth with a time limit. Explore the corridors while keeping an eye out for enemies that wander through them. Remember where paths branch so you can change course when a passage ends or an enemy gets in your way.

pages.title: Recycling Time 2
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Clean up outdoor areas in Recycling Time 2 by collecting litter and taking it to the right bins. Look at each object before you sort it, since the job is to recycle it in the correct place. Work through the area until the trash has been picked up and sorted.

pages.title: Dont Forget
pages.creator: Rich Games
pages.description: Dont Forget gives you a sequence to study, then asks you to repeat it in the same order. Watch the whole sequence before entering your answer. Work through the levels on the available difficulty settings and see how reliably you can keep the order straight.

pages.title: Rider.io
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Race a neon bike against other riders in Rider.io. Use jumps to keep moving along the highway and compete for a place at the top. Pick up diamonds during runs so you can try different futuristic bikes and upgrade your vehicle before taking on another race.

pages.title: Stickman Huggy 2
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Guide the blue monster to the finish in Stickman Huggy 2. Move along the course and jump past obstacles that block the route. Check the space where Huggy will land before committing to a leap, especially when the next hazard is close to the landing point.

pages.title: Droid O
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Defend Earth from an alien swarm in Droid O. Drag your ship from side to side to line up shots and avoid the invaders as their numbers grow. Pick up weapons such as a cannon or rockets for more firepower, or use a shield to survive as stronger aliens close in.

pages.title: Imposters 99
pages.creator: Brosco Games
pages.description: Arm yourself and fight the clone army in Imposters 99. Search each stage for weapons, then clear out every enemy to make the exit portal appear. Try different weapons as you find them. The shop also offers pets that can help you during the fight.

pages.title: City Siege 3. Jungle Siege
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: City Siege 3. Jungle Siege sends your squad into 30 stages of jungle and volcanic terrain. Build a force with units such as bombers, jeeps, or Tesla tanks, then use them to stop the Baddies. Water, swamps, bridges, and lava affect how you approach enemy vehicles and defenses.

pages.title: Build With Buddies
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Roll dice for resources in Build With Buddies, then spend them on farms, forests, mines, and quarries. The sites you build produce more resources on later turns. Decide which ones to develop first, since winning the round depends on meeting its construction objectives before your friends do.

pages.title: Quizzing Measurement
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Answer questions about measurement in Quizzing Measurement. Each question gives you four choices, and a correct first answer earns more points. Take a moment to check which measurement the question asks for before picking an option, then see how high a score you can put together.

pages.title: Flappy Demon. The Abyss
pages.creator: Izvolgar Studio
pages.description: Fly through a dark underworld in Flappy Demon. The Abyss. Pick up torches to see the way ahead and collect souls as you dodge obstacles. Keep track of both your soul supply and your lives, because running out of either one brings the flight to an end.

pages.title: Two Colors Catcher
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Drag a two-color bar under falling balls in Two Colors Catcher. Catch orange balls on the orange half and blue ones on the blue half. Watch the colors as the balls come down, since a move that catches one ball can put the wrong half of the bar under the next one.

pages.title: Block Puzzle Classic
pages.creator: gamesmunch.com
pages.description: In Block Puzzle Classic, fit the offered shapes into a grid. A full row or column disappears, giving you room to place more pieces. Think about where the larger shapes can go before filling the gaps, because the round ends once none of the available blocks fit.

pages.title: Bubble Pop
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Connect groups of at least three matching bubbles in Bubble Pop to work toward each level's goal before time expires. Longer matches can unlock powers that help with the board. Earn coins for bubble packs and power-ups, or switch to the special mode to collect more coins.

pages.title: Mega City Racing
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Take a customizable car into Racing, Challenge, or Free Drive in Mega City Racing. Enter a race when you want to compete, try the challenge courses, or spend time driving around outside an event. All three modes can be played alone or with a second player.

pages.title: Memorize Fast
pages.creator: Isaske Games
pages.description: Memorize Fast gives you a short look at a board of cards before you have to find the pairs. Turn cards over and use the locations you remember to match identical pictures. Every pair you find leaves the board, and clearing all the cards takes you to the next challenge.

pages.title: BFF High school style
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Clara, Ava, and Mia get ready for school in BFF High school style. Pick an outfit for each friend and decide how dressy or casual to make it for an ordinary day. Give the three characters different looks or choose pieces that work together as a group.

pages.title: Blocks Up
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Blocks Up asks you to make groups of three matching blocks before the pile reaches the dotted line. Watch where the blocks are getting closest to the top and look for a color match that clears room there. Keep making matches to hold the board below the limit.

pages.title: What Is Wrong 2
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Find the detail that does not belong in each picture in What Is Wrong 2. Look at the scene as a whole, then check which object clashes with what is happening or makes no sense in that setting. There are 12 pictures to inspect.

pages.title: Dominoes
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Play to 100 points in Dominoes by matching numbered ends. In Draw mode, take tiles from the pile when nothing in your hand fits, and pass if the pile runs out. In Block mode, a hand with no playable tile means you pass right away. Pick a mode and watch which numbers your opponent leaves open.

pages.title: Advance Car Parking Jigsaw
pages.creator: MaxZoon
pages.description: Drive a car through a parking course in Advance Car Parking Jigsaw. Use the arrow keys to steer between barriers and follow the route toward the checkered finish. Give yourself space to line up the next turn, especially when the course narrows around a row of bollards.

pages.title: Pair Fruits
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Turn over cards to find identical fruit in Pair Fruits. If your first two cards differ, remember which fruit each one showed so you can use that information later. Clear the pairs to finish the current board, then take on another layout in the next level.

pages.title: Jelly Matching
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Line up three or more identical candies in Jelly Matching. A successful match scores points and adds time to the round, so keep looking for the next group as soon as the board changes. Clear candies quickly enough to keep the clock running and build a higher score.

pages.title: Pong Neon
pages.creator: playfreeonline.games
pages.description: Play against the computer in Pong Neon and keep the ball in play with your paddle. Move into the ball's path and send it back toward the far side. Choose Normal or Hard before you serve, depending on how much of a challenge you want from the opposing paddle.

pages.title: Kill Virus
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: In Kill Virus, drag through at least three adjacent viruses of the same kind and release to clear the chain. You can connect them across rows, down columns, or diagonally. Long chains earn bonuses, including extra time for a chain of eight or more. Clear the requested viruses before the countdown ends.

pages.title: Free car parking games 3d : Free Parking Simulator
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Drive into the marked parking space in Free car parking games 3d : Free Parking Simulator. Steer through the parking area and give yourself room to straighten the car before you enter the bay. The 3D layout makes judging the approach and the space around the car part of the challenge.

pages.title: Car Wash Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Put together pictures of cars getting cleaned in Car Wash Jigsaw. Start with the first of twelve images and choose a puzzle mode before placing the pieces. Finish the picture to unlock the next one, and use the cars' outlines and background details to match the scattered pieces.

pages.title: Cheese Cupcakes
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Follow a recipe for Oreo cheesecake cupcakes in Cheese Cupcakes. Gather the ingredients and work through the preparations in order, using the cookies as part of the dessert. The game walks you through making the cupcakes from the first steps to the finished bake.

pages.title: Bikes Hill
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Race a bicycle over rolling terrain in Bikes Hill. Learn when to push down a slope and when to let the bike carry its speed off the next rise. Race across different maps and collect coins along the way to unlock bikes and riders for later runs.

pages.title: Boss vs Warriors
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Guide a warrior away from an evil tree in Boss vs Warriors. Keep moving as hostile creatures block the route, then dodge or attack as the situation calls for. Pick up points during the escape and try to get farther through the enemies ahead.

pages.title: Baby Day Care
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Take over as the babysitter in Baby Day Care while the parents get a break. Feed the baby, change her diaper, and help with bath time. When she is ready to play, use the toys to keep her occupied as you work through the care activities.

pages.title: Football Players Bus Transport Simulation Game
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Get the team to the match on time in Football Players Bus Transport Simulation Game. Drive the bus carrying the players and keep moving toward their destination before kickoff. You can drive buses representing different countries as you handle the trip for each team.

pages.title: Wedding Dress Up Bride
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Dress four princesses for their weddings in Wedding Dress Up Bride. Visit the salon and choose a bridal look for each of them. Start with the gown, then decide which finishing details go with it. You can give each bride a style of her own before the ceremony.

pages.title: Christmas Match 3
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Match holiday presents in Christmas Match 3 by bringing together three or more gifts of the same kind. Watch how the board changes after each match, since a group you could not reach a moment ago may now be ready to clear. Keep looking for the next set of presents.

pages.title: Push Balls
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Fill every hole in Push Balls by firing balls from the cannons around the board. Check the line in front of each cannon before you click it. The order matters when several cannons can send balls along the same part of the layout, so plan how to cover the remaining holes.

pages.title: Birdy Fun Smash
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Use the totems in Birdy Fun Smash to hit as many angry birds as you can while sparing the friendly one. Wait until a target comes into range and choose the totem that can reach it. Keep an eye on which bird is passing before you strike.

pages.title: Avoid The Wall
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Collect cubes for points in Avoid The Wall. Steer around red lines that cut across your path, and keep moving when red balls appear and begin following you. A cube may be worth going after if you can reach it without getting boxed in by the moving hazards.

pages.title: Fast Food
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: In Fast Food, try to eat the food that comes from a mysterious portal. Watch the opening and time your move as the food appears. The challenge is getting the timing and position right as each chance to catch a bite comes up.

pages.title: Halloween Defence
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Shoot down approaching pumpkin heads in Halloween Defence. Every pumpkin you destroy adds a point, and every one that reaches you costs one of your two lives. If you run out of lives, pick from four pumpkins for a chance to find an extra life and continue.

pages.title: Bike Parking
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Guide a motorcycle into marked spaces in Bike Parking. Work through the parking levels by lining up the bike and steering into the bay without hitting the surroundings. The game offers different motorcycle skins if you want to change how the bike looks between attempts.

pages.title: Bank Atm Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Explore the city on foot or by car in Bank Atm Simulator. Work through assignments involving the bank, cash, and ATMs. Use WASD to move, E to enter or leave a vehicle, and the left mouse button to attack when a mission calls for it.

pages.title: Circle Crash
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Keep your car going around the track in Circle Crash. Watch the other cars and speed up when you need to clear their path. Time the change of pace carefully so you can stay on the road without a collision.

pages.title: Classic Tic Tac Toe
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Take turns placing Xs and Os on a three-by-three board in Classic Tic Tac Toe. Make a row, column, or diagonal of three while blocking the other side from doing the same. Play against the computer or share the board with another person.

pages.title: Christmas Trains
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Drive a train around the map in Christmas Trains and pick up presents to make it longer. Take the gifts to the houses marked for delivery while other players are making their own rounds. Watch the map so you can pick a route that takes you from the next gift to its destination.

pages.title: Attack on Fatboy
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fight off an alien invasion in Attack on Fatboy. Take control of one of Earth's guardians and battle through enemy forces as you try to stop the destruction. The invasion leads to a showdown with Fatboy, the boss standing between the guardians and the end of the attack.

pages.title: Undead 2048
pages.creator: Minijuegos.com
pages.description: Slide pumpkins, ghosts, and other creatures together in Undead 2048. When two identical tiles meet, they combine into a different monster and leave more room on the board. Start with pumpkins and keep merging as the castle fills up, planning your moves to preserve space for new tiles.

pages.title: Princess Safari Style
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Style Rapunzel and Ariel for a safari-themed photo contest in Princess Safari Style. Pick an outfit for each princess with the contest theme in mind, then take a selfie to show the finished look. Give the two entries their own styles while keeping the safari theme visible.

pages.title: Judy Ear Doctor
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Judy with an ear infection in Judy Ear Doctor. Follow the treatment steps in the clinic, using the instruments as the game shows you what needs attention. Nick is worried about her, and the session focuses on getting her ear cleaned and treated.

pages.title: Zombies at the Beach
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Defend the vacationers from an invasion in Zombies at the Beach. Use your shotgun to pick off the zombies as they come across the sand. Watch who you are aiming at, since the beach still has tourists you are trying to save.

pages.title: Invert   Pixels
pages.creator: Two Hands Lab
pages.description: Make the grid a single color in Invert Pixels. Flip groups of pixels and use the controls along the edges to change rows or columns. One move can affect cells you already changed, so consider how the flips will work together. There is no timer or limit on lives.

pages.title: Princesses Christmas tree
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help the princesses put up a holiday tree in Princesses Christmas tree. Choose the tree first, then add ornaments and other accessories to make it look the way you want. Try different combinations on the branches before settling on a finished decoration.

pages.title: RoyalDice Journey
pages.creator: GamePoint
pages.description: Challenge the residents of the castle in RoyalDice Journey. You can roll up to three times to build a hand, then score a combination such as a straight, a full house, or three of a kind. Try to outscore each opponent as you work toward becoming the castle's next ruler.

pages.title: Floor is Lava VS Dancing Hotdog
pages.creator: Princess Girls
pages.description: Keep the dancing hotdog above the rising lava in Floor is Lava VS Dancing Hotdog. Jump from one platform to the next and pick up ketchup when it is within reach. You can try other characters, including a fidget spinner or a bottle, as the lava pushes you higher.

pages.title: King Bacon VS Vegans
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Defend Veganopolis in King Bacon VS Vegans by taking out King Bacon's sidekicks. Watch each target before you attack, because frightened chickens are also rushing across the screen. Let them reach safety while you clear the enemies causing trouble in the city.

pages.title: 4 Colors PGS
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Get rid of your hand before the other players in 4 Colors PGS. Match the current card by color or number, or use an action card to skip a turn, reverse play, change colors, or make someone draw. Press the 1 button when you have a single card left.

pages.title: Tiny Diggers
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Guide a group of small workers through the stages in Tiny Diggers. Give them jobs such as building stairs, digging a tunnel, or opening a pit to change the terrain. Use tools like parachutes and freezing when a route needs them, and work out which jobs must happen first.

pages.title: Rollercoaster Creator Express
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Build a ride that gets its passengers safely to the finish in Rollercoaster Creator Express. Use track pieces such as loops, corkscrews, and U-turns while staying within the budget. The game has 35 levels across five worlds, with different layouts to solve as you go.

pages.title: Fashion Designer: Dress Edition
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Design an outfit in Fashion Designer: Dress Edition. Choose a model and a dress shape, then pick a pattern and colors to make the garment your own. See how the same cut changes when you swap the fabric design or use a different color combination.

pages.title: Olli Mania
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Launch Olli into the sky in Olli Mania and see how far he goes. Keep sending him out on new attempts as you unlock upgrades for the launch. Costumes let you change his look while you work toward a better flight.

pages.title: Penalty Shooters 2
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Pick a team and play through a penalty tournament in Penalty Shooters 2. Take shots and try to save your opponent's penalties when it is their turn. The game offers 360 teams from 12 competitions, and finishing in the top two of your group takes you into the knockout rounds.

pages.title: Barbara Spy Squad Dress up
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Get Barbara and her teammates ready for an assignment in Barbara Spy Squad Dress up. Try on outfits, hairstyles, and boots for each spy. You can give the team a coordinated look or put together a different style for each member before the mission.

pages.title: Mermaid Makeup Room
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Search the mermaid princess's room in Mermaid Makeup Room. Look for her missing makeup and hairstyling items among the objects in the scene. Check the room carefully while keeping an eye on the time, since you need to find everything before it runs out.
